description: This PHP class 'InstallerCompleteController' is part of the installer system for OrangeHRM, a Human Resource Management system. It extends an abstract installer Vue controller and defines a 'preRender' method that sets up a Vue component for the installation completion screen, updates application state, and logs installation info.

classes.name: InstallerCompleteController
classes.description: Controller managing the final step of the installation process, rendering a completion component and logging installation status.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the installation complete screen by configuring the Vue component, setting application state, and logging the installation status.
